project_type: React Native / Expo monorepo with Node/Express API gateway
build_system: Expo (driver-app: ~51.0.0, passenger-app: ~51.0.0); API gateway: tsc + nodemon. No workspace-level build tool; each package is built independently.
test_framework: Jest (api-gateway only: `npm test` / `npm run test:watch`). No test framework in either mobile app.
build_command: api-gateway: `npm run build` (tsc); mobile apps: `npx tsc --noEmit` for type-check only
verification_instructions: 1. cd services/api-gateway && npm run typecheck (must exit 0). 2. cd services/api-gateway && npm test (must pass). 3. cd apps/driver-app && npx tsc --noEmit (must exit 0). 4. cd apps/passenger-app && npx tsc --noEmit (must exit 0). Run from absolute path /run/media/masalago/5a19708f-dc92-4a1e-9cea-08f3109bf2db/projects/daladala/
environment_constraints: No new npm/expo installs — all packages must already be in package.json. expo-task-manager and expo-notifications are ABSENT from both app package.json files — guard all imports with try/catch. react-native-background-geolocation and @react-native-firebase/messaging and @notifee/react-native are also ABSENT. expo-location ~17.0.0 IS installed in both apps. axios IS installed in both apps. react-native-vector-icons IS installed in driver-app. @expo/vector-icons IS installed in passenger-app. Driver-app API token key: '@skyrex:token'. Auth userId field in request: (req as any).user?.userId (used in trips.ts, drivers.ts, notifications.ts).
contribution_requirements: All TypeScript files must have 0 type errors. Read every target file in full before editing. Always use the exact migration number: next after 013 is 014, then 015. Driver status column is 'status' with value 'available' (NOT is_online).
key_patterns: API routes: Express Router, pool.query() from '../database/connection', auth via (req as any).user?.userId. Mobile API client: APIClient static class in driver-app/src/services/api/client.ts (uses fetch). Passenger app uses axios directly. Theme context in driver-app: useTheme() → theme.colors.*. Screens in driver-app under src/screens/{main,trip,auth,profile}/. Passenger screens flat under apps/passenger-app/screens/. Navigation types in MainNavigator.tsx (driver-app) as HomeStackParamList.
directory_structure: daladala/ — monorepo root. apps/driver-app/ — Expo RN app with src/ containing screens/{main,trip,auth,profile}/, navigation/, services/, contexts/, i18n/. apps/passenger-app/ — Expo RN app with flat screens/ dir and root App.tsx. services/api-gateway/ — Express+TypeScript, src/routes/*.ts, migrations/*.sql, tests/. packages/shared-types/ — shared TS types.
